method: Each idea is logged with its entry premium (net mid of the Options tab quote, per share). Each refresh re-marks every open idea from real CBOE delayed quotes (mid of the same contract legs) and checks the underlying's real daily closes against the idea's stop and target. An idea closes at expiry (intrinsic value from the underlying close on expiry day), at its time-stop date (marked at that refresh), or when the underlying closes through its stop or target (marked at the first refresh after the trigger). Win = closing return above 0%. Marks only exist for refresh dates; premium paths between refreshes are unknown and are not guessed.
